minimal_next_readiness_contract.scope: One read-only owner-facing readiness view composed from existing persisted plan, category review and partial observation readers after their independent integration/release; no new unused framework or provider writes.
inputs: Persisted owner and exact plan revision and selection
Owner-pinned product IDs and current raw category membership if available
Existing bounded inventory evidence and explicit freshness/coverage
Existing partial per-product store observations with exact window, currency, provenance and missingness
Existing platform/account-specific campaign associations or observations where available
outputs: Per pinned product: evidence available/unavailable/unknown, timestamp, source, exclusions and explicit reason codes
Show 14 versus previous 14 and 30–90 day windows as observed partial records only, with no sales/profit growth calculation where coverage or refunds are unproved
Keep each platform, account, currency and period distinct; distinguish associated campaign context from attributed orders
Show unmet prerequisites and owner inputs as unknown, including costs, season matching, full size/inventory, catalog mapping, spend cap and profitability target
Invalidate a result if the persisted plan revision or bound evidence changes; authenticate owner and bound read sizes
non_goals: No ranking by incomplete observations, sales-only or ROAS-only; no invented profit
No activation, budget authorization, provider call, policy mutation, or promise of campaign success
No claim that category snapshot proves all remote members, or that cross-platform conversions are unique orders
acceptance: Tests for owner isolation, stale/changed revision, partial/missing/refunded data, separate currency and platform rows, unavailable inventory, unknown mapping, malformed inputs and bounded reads
Independent source review and exact-source CI; integration attached only after relevant releases and retested on live site under Release Guard v5
Real external connection, provider catalog permissions, historical completeness and owner financial bounds remain separate prerequisites

next_action: Root to sequence reviewed integration/release and assign a focused readiness composition only once actual available sources are attached; audit exact current production and foreign lease before any release.
